name: hero-text
description: Text-only hero — eyebrow, big headline, subheadline, and up to two CTAs. Type-led, no media slot.

ai.whenToUse: Use when the brand is type-led and the message is short — SaaS, agency, portfolio, personal sites. Pairs naturally with a logo-cloud below for social proof.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use when the product needs a screenshot, video preview, or illustration — use `hero-media` instead. Don't use for restaurant/hospitality sites where mood is imagery-led.

eyebrow.description: Tiny pre-headline label (release name, category, tagline).

headline.description: The primary message. Keep it short and specific — one clear claim.

subheadline.description: One- or two-line elaboration. Concrete is better than clever.
subheadline.example: Helix blocks focus time automatically when your week fills up.

primaryCtaText.description: Primary CTA button label. Falls back to site.ctaPrimary.

secondaryCtaText.description: Optional secondary CTA (demo link, learn-more). Omit to show only one button.
